name: Do I need a building permit for a kitchen remodel in the Denver metro area?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a building permit for a kitchen remodel in the Denver metro area?

acceptedAnswer.text: A permit is generally required in Denver and neighboring municipalities whenever a remodel alters plumbing runs, adds new electrical circuits, or modifies load-bearing structural walls. Simple surface upgrades—such as swapping cabinet doors, replacing tile backsplashes, or repainting—typically do not need full structural permits. When mechanical upgrades or wall removals take place, plans must comply with local building codes. HH Remodeling coordinates proper framing and brings in licensed trades for plumbing and electrical rough-ins to ensure installations satisfy local municipal standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits are required for projects involving structural changes, new electrical circuits, or plumbing alterations, but usually not for cosmetic tile, trim, or paint updates.
